name: Plugin commands
author: Brett
description: Every plugin, existing and new, exposes all of its commands and reads automatically, so Claude (through axHub), the REST API and the CLI can do anything a plugin can. Commands come from what a plugin already has: its server routes (GET = a read, POST/PUT = a command, DELETE = a delete that needs a confirm token), its registered actions (run in your open console), its data folder (secrets redacted) and plugin.json commands. Surfaces: REST /api/control/<plugin>/<command>, MCP tools <plugin>_<command> plus plugin_commands, plugin_read and plugin_run on the console's /mcp, and the CLI `axf <plugin> <command>` / `axf plugins`. They follow installs, uninstalls and on/off switches by themselves. The Plugin commands page lists every command with its REST route, MCP tool and CLI line, and runs reads.
